proposal.hashNormalization: UTF-8 with CRLF converted to LF, trailing whitespace removed and one final LF

counter.testScope: Fresh local PGlite with synthetic Auth tables; deliberately denied session DELETE.

red.barrier: Second caller waits at a fixture-only INSERT barrier after its zero-row DELETE; first caller commits ten.

green.barrier: First outer transaction holds the per-user transaction lock; second caller waits before DELETE, then replaces the committed first set.

limits: Not installed in the canonical migration chain or any hosted project.
